must_find.summary: Actually ran the export with the ticket's example name 'José Ñúñez' (or similar accented input) and shows the bytes/decoded output are correct.

Points out the export is encoded as UTF-8 with a BOM (utf-8-sig) in export/csv_export.py, and that the mojibake pattern is what you get when UTF-8 is decoded as cp1252/latin-1 (e.g. a viewer/program ignoring the encoding).
Lists multiple reproduction attempts / variations (at least 2) in an attempts table.
